response.content:
## Health Tech Companies in the Danish Market in 2026

There is no single consolidated list of health tech companies that specifically "entered" the Danish market in 2026. However, based on available data, here is what can be identified about health tech activity in Denmark during 2026:

### Danish Health Tech Landscape (2026)
Denmark has a large and active health tech ecosystem. As of late 2026, there are approximately **734 health tech startups** in Denmark overall, with **266 based in Copenhagen** alone. Of these, 205 have secured funding and 72 have reached Series A or beyond.

### Notable 2026 Funding Rounds in Danish Health Tech
Several companies raised significant rounds in 2026, indicating active market participation:

- **Hi Rasmus** — Series C round in September 2026 (investor: Updata)
- **Aisel Health** — Pre-Seed/Seed round of €1.7M in August 2026, led by Caesar Ventures, with participation from Nordic Web Ventures, LifeX, Angel Invest, Rockstart, and EIFO. Aisel Health develops an AI-powered clinical operating system for psychiatry and is working with private psychiatric clinics in Denmark.
- **Kvantify** — Seed round in March 2026 (investor: Europa and others)
- **Dawn Health** — Series C round in February 2026 (investors: Cipio Partners and others)

### New Companies Founded in 2026
At least **1 new veterinary health tech startup** was founded in Denmark in 2026. Broader founding data for the full health tech sector in 2026 was not available in detail.

### Acquisitions
- **Visiopharm** (a Danish digital pathology company) was acquired by Grundium in May 2026.

### Other Activity
- Denmark's AI supercomputer **Gefion** received a DKK 500 million investment in 2026, with healthcare listed as one of its key user sectors — supporting the broader health tech infrastructure.
- The **Health Tech Hub Copenhagen** continues to serve as a gateway for startups entering the Danish healthcare market, facilitating connections with Danish Regions and healthcare providers.

If you are looking for specific *foreign* health tech companies that entered Denmark in 2026, that level of detail is not available in a consolidated form from current sources.

# Denmark-based HealthTech Startup Aisel Health Raises €1.7M Pre-Seed to Expand AI Psychiatry Platform Into the UK

The Caesar Ventures-led round will support the development of Aisel Health’s AI-powered clinical operating system, engineering expansion and entry into the UK psychiatric healthcare market.

3 days ago

Arab Founders

Aisel Health, a Denmark-based HealthTech startup developing an artificial intelligence-powered clinical operating system for psychiatry, has raised €1.7 million in a Pre-Seed funding round led by Caesar Ventures.

The investment attracted participation from Nordic Web Ventures, LifeX and Angel Invest, alongside existing investors Rockstart and EIFO. [...] The company’s approach combines AI-assisted information processing with the clinical expertise required for psychiatric assessment and treatment.

## Expanding Clinical Research and Partnerships in Denmark

Aisel Health is already working with private psychiatric clinics in Denmark as it develops and evaluates its technology.

These collaborations provide opportunities to understand clinical workflows and refine the platform based on the needs of healthcare professionals.

The startup is also conducting research with partners including the University of Southern Denmark.

The research activities are intended to support the development of technology suited to the complexities of psychiatric care. [...] Its planned expansion will allow the company to introduce its technology to a larger international market and evaluate demand beyond Denmark.

The UK entry will also provide opportunities to develop relationships with additional healthcare organizations and gather feedback from different clinical environments.

Aisel Health intends to use the Pre-Seed investment to support this expansion while continuing to develop its core platform.

The company is also preparing for a future Seed funding round as it works to strengthen its commercial position.

Details regarding the timing and target size of the planned Seed round have not been disclosed.
